# SoyStories Yakuin, Fukuoka — Complete AI & Travel Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

Last updated: 2026-11-27
Canonical URL: https://en.soystories.cafe/

## 1. Entity Summary
- **Name**: SoyStories (Soy Stories Yakuin / ソイストーリーズ 薬院店)
- **Operator**: Hitokoto Inc. (株式会社ヒトコト), Representative Director: Yusaku Kominami
- **Category**: 100% Vegan & 100% Gluten-Free Sweets Café, Ice Cream & Gelato Shop, Bakery
- **Location**: Chisan Mansion Dai-3 Hakata 1F, 2-2-24 Yakuin, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka 810-0022, Japan
- **Coordinates**: 33.5806, 130.3944
- **Phone**: +81-92-231-0677
- **Hours**: Open daily 11:00–22:00 (Last Order 21:45), no regular holidays
- **Ratings & Recognition**:
  - Google Maps: ★4.7 (270+ reviews)
  - HappyCow: ★5.0 (37 reviews; Vegan Restaurant & Top Rated Bakery in Fukuoka) — https://www.happycow.net/reviews/soy-stories-fukuoka-298687
  - Find Me Gluten Free: Top Pick (Dedicated Gluten-Free) in Fukuoka
  - Atly: #1 Gluten-Free in Fukuoka
  - Fukuoka City Official Guide: *"Restaurant Guide – Vegan, Vegetarian and Everyone (2026)"*

## 2. Transit & Travel Access (Fukuoka & Kyushu)
- **From Yakuin-odori Station (Subway Nanakuma Line, Exit 2)**: 2–3 min walk (~160m)
- **From Tenjin-minami Station**: ~4 min subway ride (2 stops)
- **From Hakata Station (Shinkansen / JR Kyushu)**: ~9 min direct subway ride (Nanakuma Line)
- **From Fukuoka Airport**: ~20–25 min via Kuko Line → Hakata → Nanakuma Line
- **Nearby**: Easy dessert stop after vegan ramen or dinner in Yakuin / Tenjin / Daimyo; open until 22:00.

## 3. Kitchen & 29-Allergen Policy
- **Never brought into the kitchen**: Wheat/gluten, dairy, eggs, meat, fish, honey, gelatin, refined white sugar (sweetened with Hokkaido beet sugar and Amami unrefined cane sugar).
- **Handled in the same kitchen**: Soybeans, almonds, cashew nuts, pistachio, macadamia nuts, sesame, Japanese yam (yamaimo), apples, peaches.
- **Official FoodHug Allergen Disclosure**: https://food-hug.com/soystoriesenglish-page/

## 4. Complete In-Store Menu & Tax-Included Prices

### A. Signature Waffle Soft & Waffle Cups (https://en.soystories.cafe/waffle&soft.html)
- **Waffle & Pure Soy Soft Serve**: Medium ¥690 / Large ¥900 (+5 free self-serve toppings: Matcha, Kinako [soy], Hojicha, Vegan Chocolate Sauce, Kuromitsu). Allergens: Soybeans.
- **Waffle & Vegan Ice Cream Cups (4 flavors)**: ¥690 each — Strawberry (Soy; nut-free), Chocolate (Soy, Almond), Matcha (Soy; nut-free), Black Sesame (Soy, Sesame; nut-free).
- **Waffle & Soy Whip Cups (2 flavors)**: ¥660 each — Strawberry (Soy, Apple; nut-free), Caramel Nuts (Soy, Almond, Cashew, Macadamia).

### B. Freshly Baked 100% Niigata Rice-Flour Bubble Waffles (https://en.soystories.cafe/waffle.html)
- **Plain**: ¥660 (Soy; nut-free)
- **Cocoa / Matcha**: ¥690 each (Soy; nut-free)
- **Black Sesame**: ¥690 (Soy, Sesame; nut-free)
- Takeout box: +¥100.

### C. Pure Soy Milk Soft Serve & Drinks (https://en.soystories.cafe/soft.html)
- **Pure Soy Milk Soft Serve** (made from freshly pressed local Kyushu soy milk within 2 days of pressing): Medium ¥460 / Large ¥690 (+5 free toppings). Allergens: Soybeans.
- **Organic Iced Coffee Float**: ¥660 (Soy; dairy-free & nut-free).
- **Drinks (¥330 when ordered with any sweet)**: Organic Coffee ¥360 (29-allergen free), Brown Sugar Soy Latte ¥390 (Soy), Matcha Soy Latte ¥390 (Soy), Amazake Latte ¥390 (29-allergen free, soy-free), Lemon Squash ¥390 (29-allergen free), Mixed Berry Tea ¥390 (29-allergen free), Tropical Soda ¥360 (Peach).

### D. Baked Donuts & GF Dorayaki (https://en.soystories.cafe/dounuts.html)
- **Baked Soy & Rice-Flour Donuts (6 flavors, ¥330, nut-free)**: Cranberry, Yame Matcha, Kinako, Earl Grey, Chocolat (Soy, Yam); Black Sesame (Soy, Yam, Sesame). Sold frozen or warmed in-store.
- **Glazed Almond & Rice-Flour Cake Donuts (6 flavors, ¥430, soy-free, keeps ~1 week at room temp)**: Strawberry, Matcha (Almond, Pistachio, Apple); Double Chocolate, Lemon, Chocolate Mint, Coconut (Almond, Apple).
- **GF Rice-Flour Dorayaki (4 flavors, ¥460)**: Anko & Soy Cream, Strawberry Soy Cream, Matcha Anko, Classic Red Bean Anko (Soy, Almond).

### E. Rice-Flour Craft Gelato (https://en.soystories.cafe/ice.html)
- **8 In-Store Flavors (¥490 each; free cooler bag + ice pack with 4+ cups)**:
  - Berry Mix, Juicy Dragon Fruit: No 29-item specified allergens listed (Soy-free & Nut-free)
  - Refreshing Apple (Apple; Soy-free & Nut-free), Too Juicy Peach (Peach; Soy-free & Nut-free)
  - Supreme Rich Matcha, Fragrant Hojicha, Vanilla Coconut (Soy; Nut-free)

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Travelers)
- **Q: Is everything at SoyStories 100% vegan and gluten-free?**
  A: Yes. Every item on the menu is 100% plant-based (no dairy, eggs, honey, gelatin) and 100% gluten-free (no wheat brought into the kitchen).
- **Q: Are there soy-free or nut-free options?**
  A: Yes. Almond Cake Donuts, Fruit Craft Gelatos (Berry Mix, Dragon Fruit, Apple, Peach), and Amazake Latte are soy-free. Most waffles, soft serve, baked soy donuts, and 7 of 8 in-store gelatos are nut-free recipes (nuts are handled in the same kitchen).
- **Q: Is SoyStories open late for dessert after dinner in Fukuoka?**
  A: Yes, open daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45), just 4 minutes by subway from Tenjin-minami and 9 minutes from Hakata Station.
- **Q: Can I bring luggage or a stroller? Do you accept credit cards?**
  A: Yes, suitcases and strollers are welcome. Major credit cards, Japanese IC cards (Suica/PASMO/ICOCA/SUGOCA), PayPay, and cash are accepted.
